Here is some Gavial The Invincible in multiple positions.

If you want me to try certain characters, let me know and I'll try to get them to work.

I saw people were asking why I made the characters happy, even if it was out of character for them. I just like seeing them happy, so sorry if it breaks the immersion for you.

This one was more difficult than characters I've done so far. Getting her tail along with her pupils being white was giving the AI a lot of trouble, but I'm glad I got what I did.
